title: A Szent Korona és a koronázási jelvények (The Holy Crown & Coronation Regalia)
grammar: Heraldic Symbolism, Constitutional Metaphors & Solemn Hymnic Registers

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say where the Holy Crown is kept and what the Doctrine of the Holy Crown says.
I can name the main coronation insignia: the crown, the sceptre, the orb and the sword.
I can say when and how the Crown came back to Hungary.
I can use the words of this lesson about the Holy Crown.
